name: David Ramirez
source:
David Ramirez, cocky and arrogant priest-and-exorcist-in-training with a kind heart, posseses the Miracle "Conquest of The Midians" which grants manipulation of sound and fire, is a womanizer, but limited solely to "his type"

His type consists solely of the disabled, ugly, overly fat, or anything he deems as not traditionally attractive.

Nephew of [url=https://vndb.org/c154099]Father Johnson[/url], childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c151500]Jack[/url], and first mate of his newly forming crew.
